newsitem.title: USA: Cable Design acquires Dearborn Wire.
newsitem.headline: Cable Design acquires Dearborn Wire.

text.p: Cable Design Technologies Corp said on Monday that it has completed the acquisition of the assets of Dearborn Wire & Cable LP and its affiliates for $75 million.
Dearborn Wire & Cable's 1996 sales were approximately $85 million and it will be accretive to earnings per share in the first year, Cable Design said.
Cable Design said it gains distribution and manufacturing facilities in Chicago, Wheeling, Ill.; Whitestone, N.Y.; Northridge, Calif., Chino, Calif., and Nogales, Mexico.
Financing for this cash acquisition was provided by Cable Design's present bank credit facilities, the company said.
